notes.title: B.I.O.T.A.: A New Jump
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today's patch brings only one change, however, we have a feeling it will be a deal-breaker feature!

Since Jumping is one of the core mechanics in platformer games, we've dedicated last few patches to this specific mechanic. This time, [b]we're completely revamping the way normal jump works[/b].

Previously, when jumping from the floor the characters always jumped to the same height, no matter how long the player was pressing the JUMP button.

Now, [b]we're going full platformer style[/b]. The jump's strength, or height rather, depends on how long the player keeps the button down. This translates to more controllable and precise jumps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/506973ff62302816d75f5793a7c851f7ede2eee3.gif[/img]

Make sure to let us know about this feature!

As always, if you like our game, please leave a review, and let us know what you think on the Steam forums or our official [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Discord server[/url]!

See you in the next one!

small bros. and Retrovibe

notes.title: Optimal optimization
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Welcome in 2023!

We’re starting a new year with a performance update right off the bat.

This update brings a brand new feature to B.I.O.T.A. - [b]Performance Mode[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/a3b580e443ffaab6da85ceefd278dcf3b33b5c1b.png[/img]

Performance Mode makes it possible to run the game or increase performance even on old machines, low specs machines, or machines without a dedicated GPU.

So if you've been experiencing input lag and/or fps drops, enable Performance Mode to increase the performance a lot.

For techie guys, how does it work?

In normal mode, the game draws the frames based on the final resolution. E.g. If you run the game in full screen and screen resolution is 1080p, so the system draws the frame at 1080p, this allows a more precise object positioning when objects coordinates aren't integer.

In Performance Mode the canvas is drawn in native resolution, and then enlarged to screen/window resolution when the frame is already rendered, this system allows a considerable saving of computing power. In this mode objects are drawn always at integer coordinates giving the game a gritty, old(er) school look

Another thing coming in this update is a fresh button in the menu, redirecting to our upcoming action roguelike,[b] B.I.O.T.A. Swarm[/b]. Make sure to check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/42a0107b1ade37536530238f8d593d9e030529ef.png[/img]

As always, if you like our game, please leave a review, and let us know what you think on the Steam forums or our official [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Discord server[/url]!

Have a stellar 2023!

small bros. and Retrovibe

notes.title: New game feature: Palette Auto-mode
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a patch to [b]version 1.0.23[/b] of B.I.O.T.A. This time we’ve got one, highly requested feature, and some balance improvements for Zeed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/7de85c7edc8dede3935c4759aa2b2abe8d453525.gif[/img]

Let’s start with the main course - [b]Palette Auto-mode. [/b]

Due to popular demand from players, we’ve added a new color palette setting. With auto-mode on, the game will automatically change the color palette when entering a new zone, choosing from a set of 2-4 most suitable palettes for that specific level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/42d9f3bc7f18b470e6cb06d2903f5bdaa58a02af.png[/img]

Now let’s move on to Zeed. To put it simply, his main weapon felt [b]too overpowered[/b]. We’ve tunned that down a bit to bring him in line with other Gemini II Squad members.

We’re constantly going through your feedback and encourage you to share your impressions and recommend us to your friends. We’re also grateful for every Steam review as they help us get in front of more players and keep us going!

Thanks for checking in, and see you next time!

notes.title: B.I.O.T.A. post-launch highlights and plans
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s been [b]two weeks[/b] since B.I.O.T.A.’s launch, so we thought it was a good time to check-in and let you all know what’s been happening behind the scenes!

First of all, thank you for playing our game and engaging with us via forums, Steam reviews, or Discord. At the time of writing this, [b]B.I.O.T.A. has 87% of positive reviews[/b], which makes us very happy and grateful! Your reviews and feedback help us get in front of more players and keep us going, so we encourage everyone to share their thoughts! 

It’s also been great to read numerous reviews done by the media outlets! The same goes for Twitch streamers and YouTubers. We love seeing you play B.I.O.T.A.! We’ve been watching you swap those color palettes, try out different heroes, and even complete the game in one sitting 👀 

We’re really proud to share some of the quotes we read about the game:

“B.I.O.T.A is one that every retro gamer absolutely needs to play.”
[b]Platinum Award [/b]– Thumb Culture

“(...) hits the spot for platforming fans and those who enjoy carefully considered backtracking.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“B.I.O.T.A is a 2D masterpiece bringing enjoyable, reminiscent Gameboy feelings.”
[b]9/10[/b] – MKAU Gaming

“Run-and-gun platformer B.I.O.T.A. delivers sleek 8-bit nirvana” – Entertainium

“B.I.O.T.A. is a love letter to retro games.” – eNRD

“I enjoyed B.I.O.T.A. immensely, everything about this game is polished, and an absolute pleasure to play” – I Dream of Indie Games

[previewyoutube=V2Up_idUvAw;full][/previewyoutube]

“B.I.O.T.A. has a sturdy foundation and fresh mechanics that make it a great game” – MegaYoYo

[previewyoutube=oob_LFc8drE;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re happy to see your activity on the forums and social media as we build our small community around the game. Ivan, the one-man-army known as small_bros, has been in his element interacting with the players, helping them with their issues, and gathering feedback for the game updates. Let him know what you think, or share your observations, and there is a big chance he’ll reach back!

While we’re on the topic of game updates, last Friday we released a patch with saving changes, bug fixes, and quality of life updates. Now it’s easier to pinpoint the reason why you cannot save in specific rooms, so you can adapt accordingly to the situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/4df40c8c0566f553cc7256432d321a120ac1cf96.png[/img]

To bring you even more fun and retro nostalgia, last week we also released the [b]Project Warlock x B.I.O.T.A. bundle,[/b] so you can grab both games with a [b]10% discount[/b]. Additionally, if you own Project Warlock, B.I.O.T.A. will be [b]10% off![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25009/Project_Warlock_x_BIOTA_Bundle/

As for what’s next…

We’re already working on future patches and updates to continue addressing your feedback and improving B.I.O.T.A. even further. Some of you mentioned that you can’t find a suitable color palette. Well, let us know what 4-color palette you’d like to see, and there’s a chance that it will be added to the game! 

Similarly, if you’d like to see another preset for controls, let us know, and maybe we’ll be able to cook something up!

That would be it for today! As we said, it's great to see a community building around our game, so don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Discord![/url]

notes.title: B.I.O.T.A. patch 1.015 is now available
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[b]Thank you for your ongoing support! [/b]We encourage you to keep playing B.I.O.T.A. and let us know what you think about it, whether it’s in the forums, Steam reviews, or on our Discord server.

We’re very grateful for the constant feedback and bug reports. We’re working on bug fixes and making the game even better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/4df40c8c0566f553cc7256432d321a120ac1cf96.png[/img]

Here’s the list of major changes introduced in the 1.015 version:
[list]
[*] New messages for can’t-save triggers. Now you will know exactly what’s stopping you from saving the game, whether there are enemies nearby, bullets flying around, or other threats. 
[*] The can’t-save zones have been perfected. Cases have been tweaked zone-by-zone. Now you should be able to save unless you are close to a trap.
[*] Markers for key cards and viridium containers have been added to the map (dot-shaped markers) This change should account for better navigation throughout the game.
[*] Windowed mode was added in the settings menu. Windowed mode was available through a hidden command (Ctrl+1). But now it’s visible in the settings for everyone who prefers windowed mode over fullscreen!
[*] Fixed a bug that prevents collecting  2 specimens in the sub-area. You haven’t been the only ones squashing (alien) bugs this week.
[*] Added an autosave point after switching off the reactor. For extra safety.
[/list]

We’re constantly going through the feedback and we encourage you to share your impressions and recommend us to your friends. We’re also grateful for every [b]Steam review[/b] as they help us get in front of more players and keep us going!

We’ve also launched [b]a new special offer[/b] with a 10% extra discount if you grab Project Warlock and B.I.O.T.A. or already own one of them and decide to buy another.

The last few weeks of B.I.O.T.A.’s development revolved around localization, squashing bugs, and tuning stuff like life-damage ratio, enemy placement, and all other variables.

We’ve also created 4 color palettes that are color-blind friendly! You can check them out [url=https://twitter.com/small_bros/status/1489705327511490561]here[/url] 

To tease you a bit more, check out this gif, we’ve prepared. We can’t wait for you to jump into this mech and destroy some alien spawns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/61750b47b41275f6acb56af2824478692f78f2fd.gif[/img]

We’re getting closer and closer to finishing B.I.O.T.A., so stay on the lookout for some special announcements in the near future 👀.

As always, please follow and wishlist B.I.O.T.A., and spread the word. Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]official Discord[/url] to share your feedback and thoughts about our game!


See you next time!

notes.title: B.I.O.T.A. Dev Update #3 - The Pegasus finally takes it to the skies
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s a brand new year, so it’s time for some fresh news about [b]B.I.O.T.A.[/b]’s development.

First of all, it took some time, but we’ve finished the [b]Dogfight segment[/b] of B.I.O.T.A. In this part of the game, you’ll pilot the Pegasus and face the Centurion in close-range combat. It’s something entirely different from the rest of the game, and we can’t wait for you to try it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/6db9d0a2cb3de35198e7a41944983749e12a29e3.gif[/img]

Another segment we’ve finished recently is the [b]Space Hornet Swarm[/b]. This time you’ll need to take down a swarm of giant mutant space hornets using a moving Space Cannon. Larger enemies require larger and heavier-hitting guns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/79df2a7a500705eda8ee7f5d0db5d36ecb3074d4.gif[/img]

We’ve also added new special weapons for two agents. [b]Nebula[/b] for Unit-34 and [b]Storm Machine[/b] for Kirill. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/e042bc6cac59d038e0f8efd4936453343ed53deb.gif[/img]

As you can see, [b]Nebula[/b] sends a cluster of energy charges around the agent, the walls don’t stop the projectiles, so it will be a great tool to clear whole rooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/7eddd4e466ad1bcbc181f30366a729644b9ff2a5.gif[/img]

While we’re talking about clearing whole rooms, take a look at the [b]Storm Machine[/b] for Kirill. It brings thunder and destructive rain, damaging everything around.

Apart from new things, we’ve spent time polishing the game and tweaking details like item prices in the stores.

Let us know what you think about the game and we hope to see you on [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]our official Discord[/url].

See you next time!

notes.title: B.I.O.T.A. Dev Update #2 - Meet Alex, a new playable character
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’d like to be faster than Santa and deliver you some fresh news about [b]B.I.O.T.A[/b].’s development before the Holidays!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/4c266374c26ce6791c9ca7ea32721cad53d91e0e.gif[/img]

First up, the new character - [b]Alex a.k.a. the Hitman[/b]. Her past remains a mystery, but it is said that she has made a fortune working for an organization of professional killers. She specializes in stealth and silent weapons. Her B-ray Gun makes the enemies look like sitting ducks,, and her special Cluster Neutron Bomb ability annihilates every enemy in the blast zone. See for yourselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/01896ef6919b70d1c822a7ef0715d74d90fdfa07.gif[/img]

We’ve also finished the [b]SHMUP[/b] section of the game which adds another layer to the gameplay experience in B.I.O.T.A. In this section, you’ll control a shuttle, collect weapon upgrades, and plow through a field of enemies. We hope it’ll bring back your fond memories of classic Shoot’em Ups.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/6f8512bae3ad912bb813e5072106faecb5c5b135.gif[/img]

As for new settings, we’ve added the option to choose between Lo-Fi and Hi-Fi [b]Color Rendering[/b]. It’s very likely that most players will be able to choose the Hi-Fi option and play without any issues, while the Lo-Fi setting is optimized for integrated graphic cards. This will allow lower-end PCs to run the game without any issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/a48d3b738101c77828db7efaae768a864f6e2bce.gif[/img]

One last minor update is the [b]Cutscene Frame[/b]. We thought it was a bit dull and empty, so we’ve decided to change it completely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/1fb40aa3dbadfa8c6bb0ba25867b6ca6035d3939.png[/img]

As B.I.O.T.A. nears completion, we’re working out the last stages of the game and adding finishing touches across the board. We’ll have more info to share in January. Follow [b]B.I.O.T.A.[/b] here on Steam, so you don’t miss it!

That’s all for this [b]Dev Update[/b]. Let us know what you think about the game and we hope to see you on our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]official Discord[/url].

See you next time!

notes.title: B.I.O.T.A. Dev Update #1 - Latest updates after the demo
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

After the last [b]demo[/b] update, we wanted to let you know about how things are going with B.I.O.T.A.’s development. We also hope updates like this will become more frequent! 

Let's dive into [b]new features coming to B.I.O.T.A.[/b]

First off, the Training Cabin inside the HQ (previously a tutorial) has now become [b]a new mini-game[/b] that will allow you to earn credits while mastering the game mechanics. The prize will be proportional to the time needed to finish the obstacle course. Satisfaction from beating your own high scores will be added fun here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/588c6147166e313a4df798981962debd3cc3b3a9.gif[/img]

Another aspect that we’ve worked on is [b]gem farming[/b]. We don’t want you to spend hours on a tedious grind for gems. Everyone needs credits for upgrades, so we want to speed up the process of earning them. In order to accomplish that, we’re introducing two types of gems: Large Gem worth 5 credits and Small Gem worth 2 credits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/20ceac88681c0c369a2d13305f4e8222867df48a.gif[/img]

Many of you asked for more agency in terms of settings, especially audio settings, so we’ve expanded the [b]audio options menu[/b]. Players will be able to turn off the rumble controller and adjust the volume of SFX and music separately. Thank you all for feedback on this, and please keep letting us know about your ideas and suggestions after playing the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/b55b8bb43fa75ddc9843014e25926c14750e7562.png[/img]

We’re also thinking of new ways you could play the game and have fun, as we feel that the base mode has a lot of potential to branch out.

Firstly we plan to introduce the [b]Arcade Time Attack[/b] mode, similar to the tutorial mini-game, but much bigger. You’ll have to complete a simulated path that runs through all 10 Frontier Horizon areas in the shortest time possible. Each death would additionally lower your final time. We can’t wait for you to try it and to hear your suggestions for other alternative modes in B.I.O.T.A.!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/15e96a5b8e8a10b1f302e6144a9b449db090f66c.gif[/img]

We’re also testing the [b]Permadeath Mode[/b] in which every character who dies during the story is permanently eliminated. It’s still at an early stage of development, so stay tuned for more details.

To end this update on a slimy note, we’d like to mention a new type of obstacle...

B.I.O.T.A.'s mutants produce looooots of slime. In zone 6, you’ll have to run through [b]layers of muck[/b] covering the floor and platforms. Step carefully, so you don’t slip into the pools of acid. You could say that now even the floor is trying to kill you. Welp, just B.I.O.T.A. things!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648069/17786cd46f95d73b83c55ae508f5bd9f116a347f.gif[/img]

That’s all for this Dev Update. Let us know what you think about new features on the Steam forum, or our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Retrovibe Discord[/url].

Remember to follow B.I.O.T.A. here on Steam, wishlist the game, and tell your friends.

See you next time!

notes.title: Arcade modes confirmed!
notes.content:
In addition to the story mode, the main mode in biota, it will be possible to play two arcade modes:

[b]Target shooting mode[/b]
Use Flynt the sniper to complete a series of "point blank-style" stages, with different sub-modes: freesyle, chrono, horde, etc

[b]Speedrun mode[/b]
attacks the time trying to complete the scenario in the monor time possible and with the least number of deaths. Here the levels have been arranged in a linear fashion and a few tricks have been added.

I do not rule out that other arcade modes may be included in the future!
